description: 2023 Annular Eclipse AM-band Recordings Victoria BC is provided by Depositing observer via Zenodo. The deposit contains wideband medium-wave recordings from Victoria, British Columbia, around an annular eclipse. This is Part 3, supplementing two other deposits, with WAV recordings inside ZIP archives and documented local interference and a short dropout. Geographic context: site; Victoria, British Columbia, Canada. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: WAV, ZIP. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the Zenodo record on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The title and obscuration date say 2023, but one description sentence says 2024. The conflict remains unresolved. Potential simulation use: Compare radio-propagation predictions against a local eclipse observation. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnu-radio offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
